silicon_quenching_2.name: Quenching of Silicon - Level 2
silicon_quenching_2.description: Simulate the quenching process of Silicon by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions, followed by relaxation under NPT and NVT conditions. Use the reaxff potential. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg) during cooling, defined as the temperature at which the slope of density (or volume per atom) versus temperature changes. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
